source_record.native_common_basis: Inventory, available capacity and time reserve are distinct; information and options count only for the stated decision or material activation path.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Carrying, standby, obsolescence, reserve raiding and activation costs count. Low-risk rapidly replaceable work may need only a small contingency and tested replacement.
attempted_contrary_interfaces: First-tier diversity treated as independent lower-tier supply.
A complete document treated as operational capability.
A partial exposure or criterion input rejected for failing the whole receiver.
Capacity, stock or staff double-counted for routine and contingency use.
Buyer savings treated as joint fair gain.

positive_controls.argument: Identifying whether reserve is stock, usable capacity or allowed time makes the interface capacity and timing promise interpretable; information about a reserve is not the reserve itself.
A justified reserve can buy a specific amount of decision time or absorb stated variability, changing whether the next irreversible commitment may safely remain open.
Separating real reserves from accidental queues exposes carrying, standby and delay costs and supplies scenario assumptions for the forecast.
A buffer portfolio identifies the kind of supplier interruption covered and its material replenishment or activation path, informing procurement timing and contingency obligations.
A verified reserve for the relevant startup uncertainty supplies a bounded support/readiness premise and can reduce a demonstrated transition shortfall.
A usable spare or available response capacity supplies one actual resource on the recovery path, whose timing and shared failure exposure can be assessed.
The portfolio makes the stock, skill, standby and delay tradeoffs explicit and exposes whether apparent support savings merely shift scarcity or workload.
A demonstrated reserve changes one consequence or recovery premise in the control decision, without collapsing other dimensions into a single buffer score.
